subsetPolicyRationale: `s.stdio.tsv@iana` is this plugin's own self-contained IANA TSV file — there is no alternate conformance profile, encoding variant or standard subclass to split against: every mutation (set-snapshot, set-trailing-newline, set-line-ending, insert-row, remove-row, set-cell, …) reads and writes the SAME single value model this plugin owns, through the SAME codec/dispatch regardless of which field or entity it touches. `✳️any` remains this artifact's only real scope.
